description: Check one phone number offline against the country's numbering plan (Google libphonenumber metadata): valid or not, E.164 form, national and international format, country, calling code and type (mobile, fixed_line, toll_free, premium_rate, voip and more). It does not show whether the number is in service or who holds it. Costs 0 credits.

country.description: Optional two-letter ISO country code for a number written without + and its country code, such as US or VN.

number.description: The phone number, best with + and the country code, such as +44 20 7946 0958.

name: data_validate_phone
title: Validate and parse a phone number
